notes.decision: Page number 112 = ⲣⲓⲃ in standard Coptic numerals (ρ=100, ι=10, β=2). The transcription's 'ⲡ[ⅰ]ⲃ' shows the editor reading the initial as ⲡ; given the manuscript page-numeral context, this almost certainly represents ⲣ. I have transcribed as ⲣⲓ̄ⲃ̄ to reflect the numerical value.

Translated as 'stronghold' parallel to the well-attested ⲙⲁⲛⲭⲓⲟⲟⲣⲉ in lines 13, 20, 26, 30 (in glossary). The variant -ⲟⲡⲉ for -ⲟⲟⲣⲉ may be scribal/dialectal or a different formation. Context (three of them surrounding the cosmos, established on foundation-trenches) is identical to the function of ⲙⲁⲛⲭⲓⲟⲟⲣⲉ in this kephalaion.

Translated 'you may discern.' Form ⲉⲕⲁ-ⲇⲙ̄ is opaque; ⲇⲙ̄ may be a Lycopolitan reflex of ⲇⲱⲙ/ⲕⲱⲇⲙ̄ 'find, search out' or related to ⲧⲱⲗⲙ. Sense 'find/discern' is required by parallel construction with ⲡⲟⲩⲙⲉⲓⲛⲉ 'their likeness/sign' and ⲡⲟⲩⲧⲩⲡⲟⲥ 'their type.'

Translated 'the burning' — Lycopolitan reflex of ⲣⲱⲕϩ 'burn' (cf. ⲣⲱⲭⲍ̄ in glossary). Substantival use as nominal element of cosmic preparation, paired with 'salt of the sea' as the watery-fiery preparation of the cosmos.
Translated 'the salty (one)' — qualitative on ⲙⲗⲁϩ/ⲙⲱⲗϩ 'salt.' Modifier of ⲡⲙⲁⲗⲁϩ ⲛⲫⲁⲗⲁⲥⲥⲁ 'salt of the sea.' Could alternatively be 'bitter' but 'salty' fits the explicit salt-context.

Translated 'as the Darkness' (directional ⲁ-/ⲉ- + Darkness). The 'preparation prepared as the Darkness' = the cosmic preparation that constitutes the dark side, paralleling the watery-fiery preparation in the preceding lines.
Translated 'this mountain of darkness.' ⲧⲁⲩ = ⲧⲟⲟⲩ 'mountain.' Cosmographic feature: the mountain of darkness in the encompassing circuits at the side of radiance.
Translated 'unto the end.' Likely ⲉ- (directional 'to') + ⲡⲧⲉⲗⲁⲏ where -ⲧⲉⲗⲁⲏ relates to Greek τέλος/τελειόω 'end, completion.' Functions adverbially as cosmic terminus.

Translated 'lamp.' Lycopolitan reflex of ⲉⲓⲏϩ/ⲉⲓⲱϩ — Crum 76b 'torch, lamp, brand.' The construction ⲗⲁⲁⲩ ⲛⲉⲓⲁϩ ⲛⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ = 'no lamp of light' fits the cosmographic context where solar light cannot penetrate to the darkness-mountain because of the gushing darkness covering the heaven.
Translated 'covering.' Likely Lycopolitan reflex of ⲇⲱⲗⲡ̄/ⲧⲱⲗⲡ̄ 'cover, envelop, hide.' The darkness covers the heaven from him (the side of radiance).

Translated 'which has been left set.' Compound: ⲥⲱⲭⲡ̄ (= Sah. ϣⲱϫⲡ̄ 'remain, be left over') + ⲁⲡⲧⲁϩⲟⲩ (qualitative-like 'in establishment'). The fire that remains-set on the earth = volcanic/subterranean fire.

Translated 'channels.' In the immediate context (where the channels of fire gush upward through them = the mountains and springs), the agricultural/aquatic 'jets/channels/conduits' sense fits. Distinct from previous 'barriers/bolts' tentative usage; cosmographic context demands 'opening' not 'closure.'

Translated 'the limb' — Greek loanword μέλος with Lycopolitan article ⲡⲧ-. Body-parts terminology applied cosmographically. Could refer to the limb of the cosmic body in the abundance of that very place.

Translated 'foundation-trenches.' Latin fossa via Greek φόσσα 'ditch, trench, foundation.' The disciples ask why the strongholds were not sent down from heaven onto pre-prepared trenches/foundations directly, but rather were sent first to earth and then cast upward.

Translated 'raised them up.' Verb of upward conveyance; likely Lycopolitan reflex of ⲱⲣϩ̄/ⲉⲓⲱⲣϩ̄ 'lift, raise.' Context demands a verb of raising-from-earth so that they may then be cast upward to the height — the two-step process explained in the Illuminator's response.

Translated 'to the height.' Possibly ⲁ- (directional) + ⲛⲟⲩϩⲓⲧ (place-name or directional 'upper north region'). Coptic ⲡⲉⲙϩⲓⲧ = 'north,' but in cosmological texts upward direction = the northern/superior region. The cosmic strongholds are cast upward from earth to encircle the cosmos.

Translated 'from the heaven.' Reading ⲡⲓⲡⲉ as Lycopolitan/scribal variant of ⲧⲡⲉ 'heaven' — could be dialectal ⲡⲓⲡⲉ for ⲡⲉⲡⲓⲧⲡⲉ or simply orthographic. The Father of Life sent the strongholds from heaven to earth.

Translated 'the Water of Error.' ⲡⲥⲁⲣⲙⲉ = the Error/wandering (in glossary). The Water of Error is sent forth into the midst of the upper archons before all things — Manichaean cosmogonic detail of the cosmic purification-process. The capitalization preserves the personified-cosmic sense.
